community_spaces.description: Manage community spaces and space groups: membership, lock screens, links, paywalls, and each space's media gallery.

community_feeds.description: Posts and the activity feed: create and edit posts, comments, reactions, bookmarks, surveys, uploaded documents and media, scheduled posts, and moderation reports.

community_chat.description: Direct and group chat: threads, group membership, messages, reactions, and blocking.

community_courses.description: Courses end to end: course CRUD, sections, lessons, students and enrolment, quizzes, progress, and the member-facing course views.

community_profiles.description: Member profiles and directory: profile fields, follows and blocks, notification preferences, memberships, invitations, notifications, and the leaderboard.

community_analytics.description: Read-only community analytics: activity over time, popular spaces, and top members.

community_settings.description: Portal settings and runtime options: colours, features, menus, privacy, snippets, follower and player settings, and CRM tagging.

community_admin.description: Site administration: licensing, managers, webhooks, topics, badges, onboarding, and the auth, email, push, PWA, storage and messaging settings.

chat/promote-chat-group-member-to-admin.summary: Promote Chat Group Member to Admin (no demote endpoint exists)

settings/install-plugin.bodyNote: Body: {"plugin": "<addon slug>"}. Unlike Fluent Forms' installer this one is allowlisted — the slug must be one of FluentCommunity's own addons, so it cannot install arbitrary plugins.

admin/add-manager.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Grants a WordPress user FluentCommunity manager access. Requires confirm:true.

profile/change-profile-password.bodyNote: Account security: changes a member's password. Requires confirm:true.
